summary: update_task (u), added in 2.8, recreates the task from its original data and re-templates it with updated task variables.
questions: What does update_task do in the debugger?

answer_card.title: update_task command
answer_card.answer_md: `u` / `update_task` (2.8+) recreates the task from its original data structure and re-templates it with the updated task variables.
